description: For any increasing bijection from the naturals onto a subset A, its even and odd indexed values form disjoint infinite subsets whose union is A; the even part represents a class strictly between zero and the class of A.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.enumeration_split (A : Set ℕ) (e : ℕ ≃o ↑A) :
  have C := Set.range fun n => ↑(e (2 * n));
  have D := Set.range fun n => ↑(e (2 * n + 1));
  C.Infinite ∧
    D.Infinite ∧
      Disjoint C D ∧
        C ∪ D = A ∧
          ⊥ <
              Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ)
                C ∧
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ)
                C <
              Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ)
                A
